updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.4.17 
- Fix FLT PLN Tab Mape not draggable 
- Fix Hold AI Transmission checkbox defualting to on and not working tuning off (dybamic Switching and Broadcast Parallel) 
- Fix TX Link with Hot Mic off not waiting for Options command sequence attempt 2. 
- F-4E WSO code tidy up and CAP time command 
- Add OpenKneeboard Out FLT PLN Tab Coordinate conversions X/Y, DMS, DDM and MGRS 
- Fix Night Mode on Stores Page FLT PLN Tab 
- Add Map Marker functionality to OKB-Out, they appear on SA map and on the COM/ROUTE page of FLT PLN tab 
- Add data blocks to bugged OKB FLT PLN Tab SA Map. 
- More precice position data conversions on Kola, CW Germany, Iraq and Syria with updated TM Projections model.
